notes.title: Update! Version 1.2 Released - Faster frame-rates
notes.content:
Due to feedback online from customers, and in-person at a VR arcade, we made the following improvements:

- Improved frame-rates, especially on the 3rd level
- Removed water effect, which worked well with a standard single camera, but made people's eyes hurt in VR
- Fixed tilt of water level camera on the 3rd level
